name: Order Cancellation Status 2 Code
definition: Specifies the current status of the order cancellation request.

STNP.name: Sent To Next Party
STNP.definition: Order cancellation request has been sent to the next party, eg, the next intermediary.

RECE.name: Received
RECE.definition: Status of the order cancellation request is received, that is, technical validation of the message is ok, and the message is now at the receiving side.

CANP.name: Cancellation Pending
CANP.definition: Order cancellation request is pending, The order cancellation request has been received but this does not indicate the order has been cancelled.

CAND.name: Cancellation Completed
CAND.definition: Status of the order cancellation request is completed. The cancellation request has been accepted and processed; the order has been cancelled.
